data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall flow right (Booking search, then xe.com conversion, then the mail draft with the matching subject and body templates), but it has four problems. It tells the automation to send the email when the true workflow says not to send and to click Discard. It drops the rule to pick the first hotel with a review score of 8 or more and to avoid Reserve, and instead treats hotel_name and eur_price as inputs when they should be read from the page. It splits the {traveler}@example.com convention into separate recipient_email and recipient_name parameters. It also names the currency inconsistently (recipient_currency in the description, target_currency in the steps). An automation built from this spec would pick the wrong hotel and could send a real email.
